Option A says the full decrease with the output effect never mattering, which is wrong. Option B reports only the output effect. Option C ignores other input prices. Option D confuses a shift with a movement along the curve. One small weakness: the stem asks for the effect and the key leaves the net direction open, but this is the standard textbook treatment and E is still the unique correct statement.
